{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This is the correct way to handle re-tested patients per documentation
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Count how many had severe baseline disease
n_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_severe = n_severe / n_patients

print(f"Total unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}")
print(f"Number with severe baseline disease: {n_severe}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
